description: Get the latest-day net ETF inflow/outflow (USD millions) for every tracked crypto asset: BTC (Bitcoin), ETH (Ethereum), SOL (Solana), XRP, HYP (Hyperliquid), DOGE (Dogecoin), LINK (Chainlink), AVAX (Avalanche), HBAR (Hedera), LTC (Litecoin), BNB, DOT (Polkadot), SUI, NEAR, TRX (TRON) and ZEC (Zcash). Positive = inflow, negative = outflow. Flows are published one business day in arrears, so `referenceIsToday` is normally false: the figures belong to `referenceDate`, the last trading day published, not to the current date. On Mondays the freshest data is Friday's. `totalUsdM` is the sum across all assets. Figures are asset-level totals with no per-fund breakdown; per-fund tables (IBIT, FBTC, ETHA and others) are published at https://cryptoetf.today/en/<slug>-etf-flows, slug = bitcoin, ethereum, solana, xrp, hype, dogecoin, chainlink, avalanche, hedera, litecoin, bnb, polkadot, sui, near, tron or zcash.
name: get_flows_summary
title: Latest Crypto ETF Flows
